chapter_mission: Toryaz Station is bombed; Tresina Lobi is killed; the peace effort collapses. Brooks Second Pinch.
chapter_turn: The book's most public atrocity lands; Mara's grief becomes a hunt within the same chapter.

scene_plan.purpose: The bombing itself — Leia on the summit floor when it goes.
Mara finds Tresina's body; grief converts to operational commitment.

exit_vector: Mara walking back to the Falcon with blood on her sleeve and the decision already made that she will find whoever arranged this.
notes: Allston handles the bombing with restraint — the blast is one paragraph, the aftermath is the chapter.
